overview.description: Warm Spring is the warmest and most golden of all the Spring sub-types. Your features are bright and clear with an unmistakably warm, peachy glow. Your skin has golden or peachy undertones, your hair tends toward warm golden brown or strawberry blonde, and your eyes are light and clear with warm flecks. Your best colors are warm, clear, and light — peach, coral, golden yellow, camel, warm turquoise, and salmon. Avoid cool, icy, or stark colors like navy, stark white, or cool gray, which will wash out your natural warmth and make you look tired.

tops.wear: Peach blouses, coral shirts, warm ivory tops, golden yellow knits, salmon button-downs, warm camel sweaters
tops.avoid: Icy blue tops, cool gray shirts, stark white blouses, navy — these wash out your warm glow

bottoms.wear: Camel trousers, warm beige pants, rust-toned skirts, olive chinos, golden tan shorts
bottoms.avoid: Cool gray bottoms, stark black pants, icy pastels — opt for warm neutrals instead

bags_and_shoes.wear: Tan leather bags, warm brown shoes, camel totes, cognac boots, warm nude heels
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Black leather bags, silver metallic shoes, cool gray accessories

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Gold jewelry, rose gold rings, warm bronze necklaces, amber stones, citrine, coral, topaz, turquoise
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Silver jewelry, platinum, white gold, cool-toned stones like sapphire or amethyst

clothes.pairing_tips: Layer warm tones together — peach top with camel trousers and tan sandals creates a harmonious warm Spring look.

foundation.wear: Warm or golden undertone foundation — look for W, Y, or N shades with peachy or golden cast
foundation.avoid: Cool pink or neutral foundations — they make your skin look ashy and lifeless

lips.wear: Warm coral, peach, salmon, warm nude, apricot, warm pink, tomato red
lips.avoid: Cool berry, blue-based reds, cool mauve, fuchsia — too cool for your warm undertone

eyes.wear: Warm brown, peach, copper, golden bronze, camel, warm taupe, coral — enhances your warm eye color
eyes.avoid: Cool gray, silver, icy pink, cool purple — creates a clash with your warm coloring

blush.wear: Warm peach, apricot, coral, warm salmon — adds a natural sun-kissed flush
blush.avoid: Cool pink, mauve, berry blush — makes your skin look cool and dull

overview.description: Light Spring is the lightest and most delicate of the Spring sub-types, bridging Spring and Summer. Your coloring is soft, warm, and gentle — with light golden or peachy undertones, fair to light skin, and light warm-toned eyes and hair. Your best colors are light, warm, and soft — light peach, blush pink, vanilla, warm white, soft aqua, and pale camel. Heavy, dark, or stark colors like black, deep navy, or charcoal overwhelm your delicate coloring. Keep everything light, airy, and gently warm for a fresh and naturally beautiful look.

tops.wear: Light peach blouses, soft coral shirts, vanilla knits, warm white tees, blush pink tops, light apricot sweaters
tops.avoid: Dark navy, stark black, charcoal — too heavy for your delicate coloring

bottoms.wear: Pale camel trousers, warm white pants, light beige skirts, soft sand shorts, ivory linen bottoms
bottoms.avoid: Dark brown bottoms, black pants, heavy dark colors that overpower your lightness

bags_and_shoes.wear: Light tan bags, nude shoes, soft beige totes, warm white sneakers, light gold accessories
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Black bags, dark brown shoes, heavy dark accessories

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Light gold, rose gold, delicate gold chains, pearl, rose quartz, peach moonstone, soft coral gems
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Heavy silver, dark oxidized metals, bold chunky jewelry — keep it delicate

clothes.pairing_tips: Keep everything light and airy — mix soft peach, vanilla, and light camel for a fresh, luminous Light Spring look.

foundation.wear: Light warm or neutral foundation — very light coverage with a warm peachy or golden cast
foundation.avoid: Heavy coverage or cool pink foundations — overwhelm your delicate coloring

lips.wear: Soft peach, light coral, blush pink, warm nude, light apricot, sheer warm rose
lips.avoid: Dark or heavy lip colors, cool berry, deep burgundy — too heavy and overpowering

eyes.wear: Soft peach, vanilla, light warm brown, rose gold, champagne, light apricot shimmer
eyes.avoid: Heavy dark shadows, cool gray, stark black liner — too harsh for your delicate features

blush.wear: Very light peach, soft coral, delicate warm pink — keep it barely-there and natural
blush.avoid: Deep or vivid blush, cool pink — overwhelming for your soft delicate coloring

overview.description: Bright Spring is the most vivid and clear of the Spring sub-types, sharing the high clarity of Bright Winter. Your features are bright and high-contrast with warm undertones — clear eyes with vivid color, warm skin with a healthy glow, and hair that tends toward warm golden or brown tones. Your best colors are bright, warm, and clear — bright coral, warm yellow, poppy red, bright turquoise, and vivid orange. Muted, dusty, or grayed-out colors dull your natural vibrancy. You need clear, bright colors with warm undertones to match your energetic and striking appearance.

tops.wear: Bright coral tops, warm yellow shirts, poppy red blouses, bright turquoise tees, vivid orange knits, clear green shirts
tops.avoid: Muted dusty colors, grayed tones, khaki — your brightness needs clear vivid colors

bottoms.wear: Ivory trousers, bright white pants, warm tan shorts, clear teal skirts, golden tan chinos
bottoms.avoid: Muted olive, dusty gray bottoms, dull colors that dull your natural vibrancy

bags_and_shoes.wear: Clear bright colored bags, warm tan shoes, bright white sneakers, coral accessories, golden accents
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Muted dusty bags, gray shoes, dull accessories

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Bright gold, warm yellow gold, citrine, clear topaz, coral gems, bright turquoise stones
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Oxidized metals, antique finishes, dark muted stones — keep metals bright and clear

clothes.pairing_tips: Do not be afraid of color combinations — bright coral top with ivory bottoms and gold accessories is a perfect Bright Spring look.

foundation.wear: Warm or neutral foundation with a natural finish — healthy glow is key for Bright Spring
foundation.avoid: Matte cool foundations — dulls your natural vibrancy and warmth

lips.wear: Bright coral, warm poppy red, vivid warm pink, bright orange-red, clear warm rose
lips.avoid: Muted nudes, dusty rose, cool mauve — too muted for your bright vivid coloring

eyes.wear: Bright coral, warm yellow-gold, clear turquoise, vivid warm green, bright copper, golden bronze
eyes.avoid: Muted dusty shadows, cool gray, dark smoky colors — dulls your bright clear features

blush.wear: Bright coral, vivid warm peach, clear warm pink — match the vibrancy of your natural coloring
blush.avoid: Muted or dusty blush, cool tones — does not match your bright energetic appearance

overview.description: Cool Summer is the coolest and most classic of the Summer sub-types. Your features have a distinctly cool, blue-pink undertone — with rosy or cool-toned skin, cool ash or mousy brown hair, and soft cool-toned eyes in blue, gray, or cool green. Your best colors are cool, soft, and muted — dusty rose, powder blue, lavender, mauve, steel blue, and soft gray. Warm colors like orange, mustard, camel, and rust clash with your cool undertone and make you look off. Your natural sophistication shines brightest in cool, elegant, softly muted tones.

tops.wear: Dusty rose blouses, powder blue shirts, lavender tops, soft gray knits, mauve sweaters, steel blue button-downs
tops.avoid: Warm orange tops, mustard yellow shirts, camel sweaters, rust — these clash with your cool undertone

bottoms.wear: Soft gray trousers, cool blue pants, dusty mauve skirts, periwinkle shorts, steel blue chinos
bottoms.avoid: Warm brown bottoms, olive pants, camel skirts, rust-toned bottoms

bags_and_shoes.wear: Soft gray leather bags, dusty rose accessories, cool taupe shoes, silver metallic bags, powder blue accents
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Warm tan bags, cognac shoes, golden accessories, camel leather

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Silver jewelry, white gold, platinum, pearls, rose quartz, amethyst, soft blue sapphire, moonstone
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Yellow gold, bronze, copper, warm-toned stones like citrine or amber

clothes.pairing_tips: Mix cool muted tones — dusty rose top with soft gray trousers and silver jewelry creates an elegant Cool Summer look.

foundation.wear: Cool or neutral-pink undertone foundation — look for C or N shades with a rosy or pink cast
foundation.avoid: Warm, peach, or golden foundations — makes your skin look orange and unnatural

lips.wear: Dusty rose, cool mauve, soft raspberry, cool pink, muted berry, blue-based rose
lips.avoid: Warm orange-red, coral, warm peach, tomato red — clashes with your cool undertone

eyes.wear: Soft mauve, cool taupe, dusty pink, soft lavender, cool gray, muted plum, rose
eyes.avoid: Warm bronze, gold, copper eyeshadow — adds unwanted warmth to your cool features

blush.wear: Cool rose, soft mauve, dusty pink, soft raspberry — enhances your natural cool flush
blush.avoid: Warm peach, coral, orange-toned blush — clashes with your cool skin undertone

overview.description: Light Summer is the lightest of the Summer sub-types, sharing delicacy with Light Spring but with a distinctly cool undertone. Your features are soft and cool — with fair, pinkish skin, light cool ash or mousy blonde hair, and soft cool-toned eyes. Your best colors are light, cool, and soft — soft lavender, baby blue, pale pink, cool white, light gray, and icy periwinkle. Dark, heavy, or warm colors overwhelm your gentle coloring. Keep everything light, cool, and understated to let your naturally soft and ethereal beauty come through.

tops.wear: Soft lavender blouses, baby blue shirts, pale pink tops, cool white tees, light gray knits, soft periwinkle sweaters
tops.avoid: Black tops, bright orange, mustard — too harsh for your delicate cool coloring

bottoms.wear: Light gray trousers, cool white pants, pale blue skirts, soft lavender shorts, icy pink bottoms
bottoms.avoid: Dark olive, warm brown pants, rust-toned bottoms, heavy dark colors

bags_and_shoes.wear: Soft gray bags, pale pink accessories, cool white shoes, light silver accents, powder blue totes
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Warm tan bags, cognac shoes, golden accessories, dark heavy bags

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Delicate silver, light white gold, pearls, light amethyst, rose quartz, soft blue topaz, moonstone
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Heavy yellow gold, bright bronze, copper — too warm and too heavy

clothes.pairing_tips: Keep everything soft and light — pale blue top with light gray trousers and delicate silver jewelry for an effortless Light Summer look.

foundation.wear: Light cool or neutral foundation — very sheer coverage with cool pink or neutral cast
foundation.avoid: Warm peachy foundations, heavy coverage — overwhelms your light delicate cool coloring

lips.wear: Pale cool pink, soft rose, sheer mauve, light berry, icy pink, cool nude
lips.avoid: Warm nudes, coral, orange-based reds, dark heavy colors — too warm and too heavy

eyes.wear: Soft lavender, pale pink, light cool gray, icy blue, soft rose, barely-there shimmer
eyes.avoid: Warm bronze, gold, copper, dark heavy shadows — too warm and too heavy for your lightness

blush.wear: Very pale cool pink, soft icy rose, light mauve — barely there and naturally cool
blush.avoid: Warm peach, vivid coral, dark berry — overpowers your soft delicate coloring

overview.description: Soft Summer is the most muted and blended of the Summer sub-types, bridging Summer and Soft Autumn. Your features are soft, cool, and low-contrast — with muted cool-toned skin, soft ash or mousy brown hair, and gentle cool-toned eyes that blend softly with your overall coloring. Your best colors are soft, muted, and cool — dusty mauve, grayed blue, soft sage, stone gray, and faded denim. Bright, stark, or vivid colors create too much contrast and overwhelm your naturally gentle appearance. Your elegance lies in your soft, harmonious blending of tones.

tops.wear: Dusty mauve blouses, grayed blue shirts, soft sage tops, muted rose knits, stone gray sweaters, dusty lavender tees
tops.avoid: Bright neon tops, pure white shirts, stark black blouses, vivid colors — your palette is soft and muted

bottoms.wear: Stone gray trousers, dusty blue pants, muted sage skirts, soft cocoa shorts, faded denim
bottoms.avoid: Bright white bottoms, neon colors, stark black pants, overly vivid bottoms

bags_and_shoes.wear: Stone gray bags, dusty rose shoes, soft taupe accessories, pewter accents, muted blue totes
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Bright gold accessories, vivid colored bags, stark white or black shoes

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Soft silver, pewter, brushed rose gold, soft amethyst, dusty pink tourmaline, grayed moonstone
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Bright shiny gold, copper, highly polished metals — keep finishes soft and muted

clothes.pairing_tips: Layer muted tones together — dusty mauve top with stone gray trousers and pewter accessories for a sophisticated Soft Summer look.

foundation.wear: Cool or neutral-cool foundation with a soft matte or natural finish
foundation.avoid: Warm golden foundations, heavy full-coverage — clashes with your soft cool coloring

lips.wear: Muted mauve, dusty rose, soft berry, grayed pink, muted cool nude, dusty plum
lips.avoid: Bright vivid lips, warm coral, orange-red — too stark and vivid for your soft appearance

eyes.wear: Dusty mauve, grayed blue, soft sage, muted plum, stone gray, dusty rose shimmer
eyes.avoid: Vivid bright shadows, warm bronze, gold, copper — too warm and too vivid

blush.wear: Dusty cool pink, muted mauve, soft grayed rose — muted and soft to match your coloring
blush.avoid: Vivid coral, bright warm peach, stark colors — too strong for your soft blended appearance

overview.description: Warm Autumn is the warmest and most golden of all the Autumn sub-types. Your features radiate warmth — with golden, peachy, or olive undertones in your skin, warm auburn, copper, or golden brown hair, and warm-toned hazel, brown, or golden eyes. Your best colors are warm, earthy, and muted — rust, olive green, camel, burnt orange, chocolate brown, and mustard. Cool, icy, or stark colors like navy, cool pink, and stark white clash with your warm earthy glow. You look most stunning surrounded by the rich, golden palette of an autumn forest.

tops.wear: Rust blouses, olive green shirts, burnt orange knits, mustard sweaters, camel tops, warm terracotta tees
tops.avoid: Icy blue tops, cool pink shirts, stark white blouses, neon colors — these clash with your earthy warmth

bottoms.wear: Chocolate brown trousers, olive chinos, camel skirts, warm rust pants, dark golden tan shorts
bottoms.avoid: Cool gray bottoms, icy pastel pants, navy skirts, cool-toned bottoms

bags_and_shoes.wear: Camel leather bags, cognac boots, warm brown shoes, tan totes, rust-toned accessories
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Black leather bags, silver metallic shoes, cool gray accessories, navy bags

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Gold jewelry, bronze, antique gold, copper, amber stones, tortoiseshell, wooden accents, citrine, tiger eye
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Silver jewelry, platinum, white gold, cool blue gems — anything that adds coolness

clothes.pairing_tips: Embrace the earthy palette — rust top with olive trousers and cognac boots is a quintessential Warm Autumn look.

foundation.wear: Warm or golden undertone foundation — look for W, Y, or N shades with a golden or olive cast
foundation.avoid: Cool pink foundations, ashy or gray-toned bases — makes your warm skin look dull and lifeless

lips.wear: Terracotta, brick red, warm brown, burnt orange-red, warm coral, deep peach, copper rose
lips.avoid: Cool berry, blue-based red, cool pink, fuchsia — too cool for your earthy warm undertone

eyes.wear: Warm brown, rust, copper, bronze, olive green, caramel, golden, warm terracotta
eyes.avoid: Cool gray, silver, icy pink, cool purple — creates an unnatural clash with your earthy warmth

blush.wear: Warm peach, terracotta, copper, warm bronze blush — earthy and warm like your coloring
blush.avoid: Cool pink, mauve, berry — these add coolness that fights your natural warm undertone

overview.description: Soft Autumn is the most muted and gentle of the Autumn sub-types, bridging Autumn and Soft Summer. Your features are softly warm and low-contrast — with light to medium warm-toned skin, soft warm brown or golden hair, and gently warm eyes that blend harmoniously with your overall coloring. Your best colors are warm, muted, and soft — dusty rust, muted olive, warm taupe, soft terracotta, and warm gray. Stark, vivid, or cool colors create too much contrast and overwhelm your naturally gentle warmth. Your beauty is in your soft, understated warmth.

tops.wear: Soft rust blouses, muted olive shirts, warm taupe knits, dusty orange sweaters, warm gray tees, muted gold tops
tops.avoid: Pure white tops, bright fuchsia shirts, electric blue blouses, icy cool colors — too stark for your softness

bottoms.wear: Warm gray trousers, dusty olive pants, warm taupe skirts, muted camel shorts, soft terracotta bottoms
bottoms.avoid: Stark white bottoms, bright neon pants, cool gray skirts, icy pastel bottoms

bags_and_shoes.wear: Warm taupe bags, muted brown shoes, soft camel accessories, antique bronze accents, dusty tan totes
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Bright silver bags, stark white shoes, icy metallic accessories

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Matte gold, antique bronze, pewter, warm amber, smoky quartz, muted citrine, soft tiger eye
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Bright shiny silver, platinum, highly polished metals, cool blue gems

clothes.pairing_tips: Blend muted warm tones — soft rust top with warm taupe trousers and matte bronze jewelry for a harmonious Soft Autumn look.

foundation.wear: Warm or neutral-warm foundation with a soft, natural finish — light to medium coverage
foundation.avoid: Cool pink or gray-toned foundations — clashes with your soft warm undertone

lips.wear: Soft terracotta, muted warm brown, dusty peach, warm mauve, muted brick, soft copper rose
lips.avoid: Bright vivid lips, cool berry, stark red — too strong and cool for your soft warm coloring

eyes.wear: Soft warm brown, muted taupe, dusty olive, warm gray, soft copper, muted caramel
eyes.avoid: Cool gray, silver, vivid bright colors — too cool and too stark for your soft warmth

blush.wear: Soft warm peach, muted terracotta, dusty warm pink — soft and warm to match your gentle coloring
blush.avoid: Vivid coral, cool mauve, stark colors — too vivid or too cool for your softness

overview.description: Deep Autumn is the darkest and richest of the Autumn sub-types, bridging Autumn and Deep Winter. Your features are deep, warm, and high-contrast — with medium to deep warm-toned skin, dark warm brown or espresso hair, and rich dark warm eyes in deep brown or hazel. Your best colors are deep, warm, and rich — dark chocolate, deep rust, forest green, deep olive, burgundy, and deep teal. Light pastels and cool icy colors wash you out completely. You need deep, warm, earthy colors that match the intensity and richness of your natural coloring.

palette.best_metals: Deep gold, antique bronze, dark copper

tops.wear: Dark chocolate tops, deep rust blouses, forest green shirts, deep olive knits, rich burgundy sweaters, warm black tees
tops.avoid: Pastel colors, pale pink blouses, baby blue shirts, icy lavender — too light and cool for your depth

bottoms.wear: Dark chocolate trousers, deep olive pants, forest green skirts, rich burgundy shorts, warm dark brown chinos
bottoms.avoid: Pale pastel bottoms, cool gray pants, icy pink skirts, light airy colors

bags_and_shoes.wear: Deep chocolate leather bags, dark cognac boots, rich brown shoes, forest green accessories, dark gold accents
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Pastel bags, light beige shoes, silver metallic accessories, cool-toned bags

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Deep gold, antique bronze, dark copper, smoky topaz, deep amber, garnet, rich tiger eye, dark citrine
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Silver, platinum, light cool gems, bright shiny metals — go deep and rich

clothes.pairing_tips: Go deep and rich — dark chocolate top with forest green trousers and dark gold jewelry for a powerful Deep Autumn look.

foundation.wear: Deep warm foundation — golden, olive, or warm brown undertone with medium to full coverage
foundation.avoid: Cool or ashy foundations — makes your deep warm skin look dull and gray

lips.wear: Deep brick red, dark chocolate brown, deep rust, rich burgundy with warm undertone, deep terracotta, dark copper
lips.avoid: Cool berry, blue-based burgundy, cool plum, pastel lips — too cool and too light for your deep coloring

eyes.wear: Deep warm brown, espresso, dark rust, forest green, deep olive, rich copper, dark bronze
eyes.avoid: Cool gray, silver, icy colors, pastel shadows — too light and too cool for your intense depth

blush.wear: Deep warm terracotta, rich copper, dark warm peach, deep bronze blush
blush.avoid: Light pastels, cool pink, icy tones — disappear against your deep coloring

overview.description: Cool Winter is defined by cool undertones, high contrast, and a naturally bold, striking appearance. Your features are clear and high-contrast — with cool pink or blue undertones in your skin, dark cool brown or black hair, and bright cool-toned eyes in blue, gray, or cool green. Your best colors are pure, icy, or deeply saturated — true white, cobalt, navy, emerald, true red, fuchsia, hot pink, and burgundy. Warm, earthy colors like beige, camel, rust, olive, and orange completely wash out your natural vibrancy. Silver jewelry always flatters you more than gold.

tops.wear: True red blouses, cobalt blue shirts, fuchsia tops, hot pink knits, icy lavender tees, emerald green button-downs, crisp white shirts, black tops
tops.avoid: Peach tops, camel sweaters, rust blouses, warm orange shirts — these dull your natural vibrancy

bottoms.wear: Black trousers, charcoal pants, navy skirts, cobalt blue shorts, deep burgundy chinos, crisp white bottoms
bottoms.avoid: Warm brown bottoms, olive pants, camel skirts, beige trousers

bags_and_shoes.wear: Black leather bags, white structured bags, navy totes, deep burgundy shoes, cobalt accessories, silver metallic bags
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Tan bags, camel shoes, warm brown leather, golden accessories

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Silver jewelry, white gold, platinum, diamonds, sapphires, rubies, emeralds, amethysts, pearls
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Yellow gold, rose gold, warm bronze, amber stones, citrine — adds unwanted warmth

clothes.pairing_tips: High contrast works in your favor — bold cobalt top with black trousers and silver jewelry is a signature Cool Winter look.

foundation.wear: Cool or neutral-pink undertone foundation — look for C or N shades with a rosy or neutral cast
foundation.avoid: Warm, peach, or golden foundations — makes skin look orange and unnatural

lips.wear: Blue-based reds, true red, berry, fuchsia, hot pink, deep burgundy, cool nude leaning rosy
lips.avoid: Warm peach nudes, coral, warm orange-red — clashes with your cool high-contrast coloring

eyes.wear: Icy pink, silver, charcoal, navy, deep plum, cool gray, black liner and mascara
eyes.avoid: Warm brown, bronze, gold eyeshadow — adds warmth that fights your cool natural contrast

blush.wear: Cool rose, raspberry, soft fuchsia, cool pink — enhances your natural cool flush
blush.avoid: Warm peach, coral, orange-toned blush — clashes with your cool undertone

overview.description: Deep Winter is the darkest and most dramatic of the Winter sub-types, bridging Winter and Deep Autumn with a cool undertone. Your features are deep, cool, and high-contrast — with medium to deep cool-toned skin, very dark brown or black hair, and dark cool-toned eyes in deep brown, black-brown, or dark hazel. Your best colors are deep, cool, and rich — true black, deep navy, dark burgundy, deep plum, dark forest green, and charcoal. Light, warm, or pastel colors completely disappear against your deep, intense coloring. You look most powerful in deep, cool, dramatic tones.

palette.avoid_metals: Yellow gold, rose gold, warm bronze

tops.wear: True black tops, deep navy blouses, dark burgundy shirts, deep plum knits, dark forest green tees, charcoal sweaters
tops.avoid: Pastel yellow tops, light peach blouses, warm beige shirts, light dusty rose — too soft for your depth

bottoms.wear: Black trousers, deep navy pants, dark charcoal skirts, rich burgundy shorts, dark espresso chinos
bottoms.avoid: Light warm beige bottoms, camel pants, light gray skirts, pastel bottoms

bags_and_shoes.wear: Black leather bags, deep navy totes, dark charcoal shoes, graphite accessories, dark silver accents
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Light tan bags, warm beige shoes, camel leather, golden metallic accessories

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Silver, dark silver, gunmetal, onyx, dark sapphire, deep amethyst, black diamonds, hematite
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Yellow gold, rose gold, warm bronze, amber, citrine — adds warmth that clashes with your cool depth

clothes.pairing_tips: Embrace deep monochromatic dressing — all-black or black with deep navy creates a striking, powerful Deep Winter look.

foundation.wear: Deep cool or neutral foundation — medium to full coverage with cool or neutral undertone
foundation.avoid: Warm or golden foundations — creates an orange cast on your cool deep skin

lips.wear: Deep plum, dark burgundy, dark navy red, deep berry, oxblood, dark chocolate with cool undertone
lips.avoid: Warm nudes, coral, warm red, peach — too warm and too light for your deep cool intensity

eyes.wear: Charcoal, dark navy, deep plum, onyx, dark gray, graphite — dramatic and deep
eyes.avoid: Warm bronze, gold, copper, light pastels — too warm and too light for your deep dramatic features

blush.wear: Deep cool berry, dark raspberry, deep cool rose — deep and cool to match your intensity
blush.avoid: Light peach, warm coral, soft pink — too light and too warm, disappears or clashes

overview.description: Bright Winter is the most vivid and clear of the Winter sub-types, sharing the brightness of Bright Spring but with a distinctly cool undertone. Your features are bright, cool, and high-contrast — with clear cool-toned skin, dark hair, and strikingly vivid cool-toned eyes that command attention. Your best colors are bright, cool, and clear — true white, black, bright cobalt, true red, hot pink, electric blue, emerald, and fuchsia. Warm, muted, or dusty colors dull your natural brilliance. You thrive in the most vivid, clear, and high-contrast color combinations.

palette.avoid_metals: Yellow gold, rose gold, antique metals

tops.wear: True white blouses, black tops, bright cobalt shirts, true red knits, hot pink tees, electric blue button-downs, vivid fuchsia tops
tops.avoid: Warm beige tops, camel sweaters, orange shirts, mustard blouses, muted dusty colors

bottoms.wear: Black trousers, white pants, navy skirts, cobalt blue shorts, crisp white chinos, dark navy bottoms
bottoms.avoid: Warm camel bottoms, olive pants, beige skirts, muted warm-toned bottoms

bags_and_shoes.wear: Black leather bags, white structured bags, bright cobalt accessories, silver metallic shoes, vivid clear-colored bags
bags_and_shoes.avoid: Warm tan bags, camel shoes, golden accessories, muted warm-toned bags

metals_jewelry_gems.wear: Bright silver, polished white gold, crystal, diamonds, clear sapphire, bright amethyst, vivid blue topaz
metals_jewelry_gems.avoid: Yellow gold, rose gold, antique metals, warm amber stones — keep metals bright and clear

clothes.pairing_tips: Maximum contrast is your superpower — true white top with black trousers and bright silver jewelry is the perfect Bright Winter statement.

foundation.wear: Cool or neutral foundation with a natural to luminous finish — your skin needs to glow
foundation.avoid: Matte warm foundations, yellow or peachy bases — dulls your natural bright contrast

lips.wear: True red, hot pink, bright fuchsia, vivid berry, electric pink, clear cool red — bold and bright
lips.avoid: Muted nudes, warm coral, dusty rose — too muted for your bright vivid coloring

eyes.wear: Bright silver, icy blue, vivid plum, clear cobalt, electric teal, stark black liner — bold and clear
eyes.avoid: Muted warm colors, bronze, gold, dusty shadows — dulls your bright clear features

blush.wear: Bright cool pink, vivid rose, clear fuchsia — bold and vivid to match your bright coloring
blush.avoid: Warm peach, muted mauve, dusty colors — too soft and too warm for your vibrancy
